messages:
alex: Quick heads-up — doing a Silent Ops handoff for the weekend release. Plan: staggered canary rollout 10% -> 50% -> 100%. We need final pin + rollback decisions for the hotfix branch. @tara @kevin please ack.

deploy-bot: deploy started by jamie. canary 10% to eu1 at 2026-03-20T02:00Z
deploy-bot: canary health: 99% success, 2 slow responses > 1.5s, avg latency 420ms

tara: Ack. Pin the gateway version to `v2.4.7-hotfix-2026-03-20`. Keep previous `v2.4.6` in reserve and do not auto-delete images.

kevin: Agree on pin. Rollback criteria: if error rate > 1% for 5m OR p95 latency > 1s for 10m then auto-rollback. Add manual "stop traffic" gate if DB write errors appear.

alex: Confirmed. jamie, attach release note snippet and the runbook link in thread. Also ensure no config changes during canary (batch_size locked).

jamie: Release note snippet: "hotfix: fix malformed request header causing partial reject for long prompts. Applies to API frontend and routing."
Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/hotfix-2026-03-20
PRs: https://git.internal/redwood/releases/pull/1942

sre-rotation: Adding observability checks: create alert `canary-error-rate > 0.8% (5m)` and route to oncall. Add dashboard tile for `p95 latency` + `5m error %.`

tara: Also lock embedding model version at `m-embed-1.9-quant` to avoid regression. If memory OOMs, fallback to `m-embed-1.8`. Documented in runbook under "fallbacks".

deploy-bot: Canary at 50% started. health: 98.5% trending up. metrics: errors 0.45%, p95 560ms.

kevin: Noted. Documenting rollback owners: tara (primary), alex (secondary). Manual rollback steps in runbook: `1) stop traffic 2) revert infra-pin 3) redeploy v2.4.6 4) validate`

alex: Small config note — avoid changing `batch_size` or `max_concurrency` during canary. Already locked to `batch_size=16`.

jamie: Tagging release: `release/hotfix/2026-03-20` pinned to infra tag `infra-pin-12`. All CI green.

deploy-bot: Canary at 100% complete. Final health: errors 0.4%, p95 510ms. No DB write errors. Deployment marked successful.

alex: :thumbsup: We'll keep the silent window until 05:00Z. If any critical issue, ping #eng-oncall and @sre-rotation. Closing handoff — thanks team.

tara: ack, monitoring in place.

kevin: ack — will be standing by for 2 hours.
